WITH payment_by_receivable AS (
  SELECT receivable_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_amount
  FROM payment
  WHERE payment_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY receivable_id
)
SELECT d.name AS department_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(p.paid_amount, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(r.receivable_amount), 0) AS collection_rate
FROM receivable r
JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = r.order_id
JOIN org_department d ON d.id = so.department_id
LEFT JOIN payment_by_receivable p ON p.receivable_id = r.id
WHERE so.status = 'APPROVED'
  AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY d.id, d.name
ORDER BY collection_rate DESC

WITH payment_by_receivable AS (
		SELECT receivable_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_amount
		FROM payment
		WHERE payment_date < '2026-01-01'
		GROUP BY receivable_id
	)
SELECT d.name AS department_name
	, SUM(COALESCE(p.paid_amount, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(r.receivable_amount), 0) AS collection_rate
FROM receivable r
	JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = r.order_id
	JOIN org_department d ON d.id = so.department_id
	LEFT JOIN payment_by_receivable p ON p.receivable_id = r.id
WHERE so.status = 'APPROVED'
	AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
	AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY d.id, d.name
ORDER BY collection_rate DESC

sql:
WITH expense_monthly AS (
  SELECT department_id, DATE_FORMAT(expense_date, '%Y-%m') AS period, category, SUM(amount) AS expense_amount
  FROM expense
  WHERE status = 'APPROVED'
  GROUP BY department_id, DATE_FORMAT(expense_date, '%Y-%m'), category
)
SELECT d.name AS department_name, b.category, b.budget_amount, COALESCE(e.expense_amount, 0) AS expense_amount, COALESCE(e.expense_amount, 0) / NULLIF(b.budget_amount, 0) AS budget_execution_rate
FROM budget b
JOIN org_department d ON d.id = b.department_id
LEFT JOIN expense_monthly e ON e.department_id = b.department_id AND e.period = b.period AND e.category = b.category
WHERE b.period = '2025-12'
  AND COALESCE(e.expense_amount, 0) > b.budget_amount
ORDER BY budget_execution_rate DESC

WITH expense_monthly AS (
		SELECT department_id, DATE_FORMAT(expense_date, '%Y-%m') AS period, category
			, SUM(amount) AS expense_amount
		FROM expense
		WHERE status = 'APPROVED'
		GROUP BY department_id, DATE_FORMAT(expense_date, '%Y-%m'), category
	)
SELECT d.name AS department_name, b.category, b.budget_amount
	, COALESCE(e.expense_amount, 0) AS expense_amount
	, COALESCE(e.expense_amount, 0) / NULLIF(b.budget_amount, 0) AS budget_execution_rate
FROM budget b
	JOIN org_department d ON d.id = b.department_id
	LEFT JOIN expense_monthly e
	ON e.department_id = b.department_id
		AND e.period = b.period
		AND e.category = b.category
WHERE b.period = '2025-12'
	AND COALESCE(e.expense_amount, 0) > b.budget_amount
ORDER BY budget_execution_rate DESC

  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(so.order_date, '%Y-%m')
),
full_months AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month,
         COALESCE(ms.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms ON ms.month = DATE_FORMAT(m.month_start, '%Y-%m')
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT month,
         sales_amount,
         LAG(sales_amount) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_sales_amount
  FROM full_months
),
compare AS (
  SELECT month,
         sales_amount,
         CASE
           WHEN prev_sales_amount IS NULL THEN NULL
           WHEN sales_amount < prev_sales_amount THEN 1
           ELSE 0
         END AS is_decline
  FROM with_prev
)
SELECT month,
       sales_amount,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT MIN(c2.is_decline) FROM compare c2) = 1 THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS is_continuous_monthly_decline
FROM compare
